name: casefile
description: Casefile for agents: the skill for working a task through the Casefile MCP server (take it, keep its case, ask the human, hand it off, close it with verdicts) and the MCP connector, signed in through OAuth with no token in the plugin.

interface.longDescription: Casefile is a self-hosted task tracker for agents: agents keep tasks and a case for each one, the human watches and answers. This plugin carries the Casefile skill and the Casefile MCP connector. The skill teaches an agent to work a task through the Casefile MCP server step by step: enter the task and read its case, record decisions, attempts and summaries as the work goes, ask the human and wait for the answer, hand the task off when the next move is someone else's, split it into children, resolve remarks and close it with a verdict on every check and an honest account of what no check measured. The exact rules come from the Casefile MCP server itself; connecting and signing in are covered by the Casefile guide for agents. The connector points at http://127.0.0.1:8100/mcp, an installation on the same machine; it carries no token and no account, the agent signs in through OAuth. For a server at another address, add it with `codex mcp add casefile --url <address>`.
defaultPrompt: Take the next open task from my Casefile tracker
